International Assistance Programs.title: Poland 2024 signed FMS agreements with published package values
International Assistance Programs.basis: Official Polish Ministry of National Defence signing-day pages report about $10.0B for Apache, $2.53B net for IBCS, $960M for BARBARA aerostats and $735M for JASSM-ER. These selected signed-package values total about $14.225B but do not reconcile to DSCA's $15.490B FY2024 implemented-transfer value: they are rounded, incomplete, and use agreement rather than Historical Sales Book valuation. Separate source boundary: these rows reconcile only to this panel's published agreement total and must not be added to DSCA transfers, Treasury cash, financing principal, or another panel describing the same acquisition.

International Assistance Programs.title: Türkiye F-16 notification estimate by statutory value class
International Assistance Programs.basis: DSCA Transmittal 23-07 splits the $23.0B maximum notification estimate into exact statutory classes. The $15.3B MDE class is the deepest defensible public monetary ceiling because the notice publishes article quantities but no article-level prices. Separate source boundary: these rows reconcile only to this panel's published notification total and must not be added to DSCA transfers, Treasury cash, financing principal, or another panel describing the same acquisition.
rows: 40 new F-16 Block 70 aircraft, 79 modernizations, engines, radars, mission systems and listed missile/bomb families · public disclosure ceiling
Non-MDE communications, protection, software, spares, construction, training, transport and technical/logistics support

International Assistance Programs.title: Türkiye current F-16 package estimate after scope reduction
International Assistance Programs.basis: Türkiye's defence minister told Parliament that the 79 imported modernization kits had been dropped, $1.4B had been paid, and the remaining 40 new F-16 Block 70 aircraft plus munitions would total approximately $6.5B-$7B. The displayed $7B is the upper end of that official public estimate, not an exact contract price, booked U.S. receipt, or amount to add to the earlier $23B DSCA maximum notification.
International Assistance Programs.sourceLabel: Türkiye Grand National Assembly · 2025 defence-budget committee report
rows: Approximate $6.5B-$7B current package · $1.4B initial payment disclosed · 79 imported modernization kits removed
